title: Tencent AI Advances Across the Board: Hy4 to be Launched Soon, WorkBuddy Continues to Lead, and Weixiao Expands Gray Testing

content_html:
On August 12, Tencent Holdings (00700.HK) released its second-quarter financial results, with AI serving as the core theme throughout the quarter: from completing a reconstruction and launching Hy3 preview within less than three months, to rapidly iterating to the official version of Hy3, and then planning to launch Hy4 with a larger parameter scale in the near future, Huan Yuan is forming a stable and systematic model development capability; Tencent has initially established an advantage in the office intelligence field, with multiple products working simultaneously; WeChat's AI assistant "Xiaowei" was launched in June and continues to expand its gray-scale testing scope.

The fundamentals of Tencent remained solid this quarter: revenue reached 204.79 billion yuan, an increase of 11% year-over-year; Non-IFRS operating profit reached 75.64 billion yuan, up 9% year-over-year. If excluding the impact of new AI products (mainly Hy, Yuanbao, CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, and Xiaowei), Non-IFRS operating profit increased by 19% to 86.1 billion yuan.

A strong business model and robust fundamentals support more substantial AI investment: R&D expenditure for this quarter reached 27.28 billion yuan, up 35% year-over-year; capital expenditures reached 52.78 billion yuan, up 176% year-over-year, with a 65% increase quarter-over-quarter. If excluding prepayments for computing power procurement, free cash flow reached 37.6 billion yuan. As AI contributes more incremental value to core businesses, the positive feedback loop between investment, implementation, and business returns is gradually strengthening.

Ma Huateng, Chairman and CEO of Tencent, stated: "As we enter the third quarter of this year, we are building a new, AI-powered Tencent at three levels: intelligence, applications, and infrastructure, and have made significant progress. In the intelligence layer, the official version of Hy3 provides users with a widely applicable and cost-effective model, laying the foundation for the Hy series models to reach industry-leading levels. In the application layer, AI office efficiency service WorkBuddy and AI programming tool CodeBuddy achieved breakthrough user growth and are now leading in their respective fields in China. In the infrastructure layer, we have significantly increased computing power procurement, which will help convert application and model usage into revenue. At the same time, we continue to refine our existing businesses, with marketing services revenue continuing to grow, several new games performing well, and WeChat video number playback volume growing rapidly."

Hy3 performance and usage rise together, Hy4 is about to take over, and the model base continues to strengthen

After a comprehensive reconstruction of infrastructure such as pre-training and reinforcement learning, Huan Yuan quickly completed the iteration of Hy3 from preview to official version this quarter, and the upcoming Hy4 will further enhance model performance and multimodal capabilities.

As a core achievement of this iteration, Hy3 demonstrates higher "intelligent density," achieving intelligent levels comparable to domestic and international flagship models with two to five times larger parameter scales, but with relatively smaller parameters.

Model and AI product Co-Design (collaborative design) has also become an important path for Huan Yuan's iteration and upgrading. Currently, Hy3 has been quickly integrated into products such as WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, Yuanbao, ima, and Marvis, bringing obvious experience improvements. Among them, the task resolution rate of WorkBuddy increased from 72% to 90%.

Improved model capabilities have led to a rapid increase in usage. According to OpenRouter's token consumption, Hy3 has consistently ranked among the top three globally since its launch. Additionally, the daily token usage of Hy3 is seven times that of the preview version, reflecting faster user adoption and rising paid demand.

User choices provide more direct feedback. Among users who selected models in WorkBuddy, 60% chose Hy3; after integrating with ima Copilot, Hy3 became the most used model on the platform within 72 hours.

WorkBuddy continues to lead, Xiaowei expands gray-scale testing, and AI products achieve large-scale deployment

While model iteration accelerates, Tencent's AI products begin to move from single breakthroughs to scaling up: WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, and other office agents show clear growth momentum. The enterprise WeChat AI assistant "Dayuan" was launched, and the native WeChat AI assistant "Xiaowei" continues to expand its gray-scale testing. The creative intelligent agent Miora, which shares the same architecture as WorkBuddy, has also gone live full-time.

Among these, office agents first formed a matrix advantage. WorkBuddy achieved rapid user growth and healthy user retention rates, with strong user willingness to subscribe and recharge tokens. Thanks to strong harness engineering capabilities, a rich selection of models, and an industry-leading skill library, WorkBuddy has become a leading AI-native office intelligence agent in China.

According to the E-consulting "Market Insight Report on Chinese Office Intelligence Platforms Q2 2026", the PC access volume of WorkBuddy reached 20.97 million times in June, ranking first among similar products domestically, exceeding the combined access volumes of the second and third places; in the monthly access volume top ten list, Tencent occupied four positions, with WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, QClaw, and Marvis all included.

Based on its own ecosystem advantages, Tencent is amplifying the differentiated competitiveness of office intelligence agents. WorkBuddy can integrate with WeChat and Enterprise WeChat, deeply entering real work scenarios. Recently, it also connected document and knowledge base workflows, and launched the "Human-Machine Dual Writing" function, exploring a new form of Office in the AI era.

Outside of personal office, the application boundaries of Tencent's office agents are also expanding into enterprises and industries. Currently, WorkBuddy has been applied in over 50 industries, covering areas such as government affairs, production, and life services, and has been implemented in scenarios like Guangdong government affairs and Shenzhen Port. The enterprise version of WorkBuddy has been officially launched, with commercialization and ecological cooperation proceeding simultaneously.

The AI layout in the enterprise segment continues to deepen into existing collaboration channels. In the second quarter, Enterprise WeChat launched several AI functions including recording face-to-face meetings and intelligent documents, and introduced the intelligent assistant "Dayuan," directly embedded in the workflow, covering scenarios such as group chats, to-do lists, and emails. It can complete tasks such as chat summaries, document and table reading and writing, and project progress summaries, and connect external WeChat group chats, more naturally integrating into the enterprise collaboration process.

Outside of office and enterprise scenarios, Tencent's AI products are also accelerating into personal life scenarios. The native WeChat AI assistant "Xiaowei" launched in June continues to expand its gray-scale testing, with entry points extending from the main entrance of WeChat's home screen to more scenarios such as Moments, official accounts, and video numbers. Xiaowei is based on the self-developed WeLM model by the WeChat team, focusing on user privacy, WeChat scenario adaptation, and inference efficiency, while enhancing personalized AI experiences through official accounts and video numbers.

Yuanbao continues to strengthen core experiences such as search and voice recognition, and reuses the accumulated AI atomic capabilities in products like WeChat, WorkBuddy, and QQ Browser.

AI drives cloud service growth, games and advertising maintain growth, and several long-standing games see record daily active users

In the second quarter, all three of Tencent's major business segments achieved growth, with the contribution of AI core businesses deepening. Among them, financial technology and enterprise services revenue increased by 9% to 60.29 billion yuan, with cloud services becoming the most direct contributor to AI-driven growth.

Specifically, the growth in demand for model inference, intelligent body operation, and AI-native applications has driven increased demand for computing power, MaaS, and API calls. AI products and services such as WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy also contributed new revenue. Tencent Cloud's overseas business continued to expand rapidly, with this quarter supporting Indonesia's leading operator XLSMART in a large-scale public cloud migration and applying WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy AI capabilities in the migration process; general cloud service demand also maintained growth.

In gaming, AI has become an important force driving business growth and has been deeply integrated into the entire player experience, development production, and operation service chain. For example, "Delta Operation" uses Agents to improve operational efficiency and leverages Hy3D capabilities to optimize the scene-end hand integration production pipeline.

At the same time, the exploration of AI and gameplay integration continues. The AI NPC gameplay of "PUBG Mobile" has accumulated 167 million users, with the highest daily active users reaching 17.7 million; the new game "Kingdom of Roche: World" introduced a game-native Coach Agent "Scarlett" for complex gameplay decision-making, which has effectively promoted PVP ice-breaking and activity since its launch, increasing PVP activation by 20%, and improving win rates after users engaged with the features, thus enhancing the gameplay experience.

In terms of business performance, the game revenue for this quarter reached 65.9 billion yuan, up 11% year-over-year, returning to double-digit growth. Domestic market revenue reached 47.3 billion yuan, up 17% year-over-year. The growth drivers mainly come from four core products: "Delta Operation," "Valorant," "Valorant: Energy Operation," and "Kingdom of Roche: World." Among them, the daily active users of "Delta Operation" and "Valorant" both reached historic highs this quarter, maintaining Tencent's leading position in the shooting category and competitive arena.

International game market revenue reached 18.6 billion yuan, up 4% year-over-year on a fixed exchange rate basis, mainly driven by "Arknights" and "VALORANT"; meanwhile, Miniclip under Tencent achieved a breakthrough success in the international market, with the product "Arrows - Puzzle Escape" becoming the top downloaded mobile game globally in the second quarter.

In marketing services, AI continues to drive improvements in advertising campaign efficiency. Marketing services revenue for this quarter reached 43.57 billion yuan, up 22% year-over-year, continuing to grow faster than the industry. The customer coverage of the "Tencent Marketing AIM+" smart advertising product matrix remains above 80%, with AI creative capabilities improving material production efficiency by nearly 80%.

The advertising recommendation model "Scaling Up" has been upgraded to build a new generation of advertising training and inference infrastructural technology base. Taking the video number advertising recommendation scenario as an example, the scale of the ultra-large sorting model increased by 30 times, and the computational workload increased by 24 times, with these capabilities now extended to more WeChat scenarios such as official accounts and mini programs.

AI is also accelerating integration into WeChat's existing products and ecosystem. In addition to launching the AI assistant Xiaowei, the appeal of the mini program ecosystem to developers continues to grow, with AI-native applications accelerating their emergence, and AI application mini programs growing nearly 40% in half a year. The "WeChat Mini Program Growth Plan" has increased the large model token quota to 1 billion, attracting 63,000 mini programs to participate, with over 60% coming from individual developers; official accounts have launched AI one-click formatting and are conducting gray-scale testing of AI avatars, improving content creation and user service efficiency; WeChat Pay has launched the "AI Dedicated Card," which is the first to be integrated with WorkBuddy, allowing users to express consumer needs to the intelligent agent, experiencing an automated consumer cycle from intelligent recommendations, ordering to payment.

Rich AI capabilities continue to activate the WeChat ecosystem. This quarter, the combined monthly active accounts of WeChat and WeChat reached 1.439 billion, with the total user usage time of the video number increasing by more than 20% year-over-year, driven by increasingly rich content for young users, upgrades in interactive functions, and a new content mixing system; during this year's "618" shopping festival, the transaction amount in the store and card package scenarios increased by 537%, becoming a new place for merchants' development, with the number of brands achieving a transaction volume of millions increasing by more than 200%, and the number of merchants achieving a transaction volume of millions increasing by 564%; mini program overseas services have further expanded, with the monthly transaction count in Southeast Asia increasing by 160% year-over-year.

sentences.en: As a core achievement of this iteration, Hy3 demonstrates higher "intelligent density," achieving intelligent levels comparable to domestic and international flagship models with two to five times larger parameter scales, but with relatively smaller parameters.
sentences.zh: 作为本次迭代的核心成果，Hy3展现出了更高的“智能密度”，在参数规模相对较小的情况下，达到了媲美国内外旗舰车型2-5倍的智能水平。

blocks.html_en: Model and AI product Co-Design (collaborative design) has also become an important path for Huan Yuan's iteration and upgrading. Currently, Hy3 has been quickly integrated into products such as WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, Yuanbao, ima, and Marvis, bringing obvious experience improvements. Among them, the task resolution rate of WorkBuddy increased from 72% to 90%.

sentences.en: Model and AI product Co-Design (collaborative design) has also become an important path for Huan Yuan's iteration and upgrading.
sentences.zh: 模型与AI产品Co-Design（协同设计）也成为寰远迭代升级的重要路径。

sentences.en: Currently, Hy3 has been quickly integrated into products such as WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, Yuanbao, ima, and Marvis, bringing obvious experience improvements.
sentences.zh: 目前，Hy3已快速集成到WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy、元宝、ima、Marvis等产品中，带来明显的体验提升。

sentences.en: Among them, the task resolution rate of WorkBuddy increased from 72% to 90%.
sentences.zh: 其中，WorkBuddy的任务解决率从72%提升至90%。

blocks.html_en: Improved model capabilities have led to a rapid increase in usage. According to OpenRouter's token consumption, Hy3 has consistently ranked among the top three globally since its launch. Additionally, the daily token usage of Hy3 is seven times that of the preview version, reflecting faster user adoption and rising paid demand.

sentences.en: Improved model capabilities have led to a rapid increase in usage.
sentences.zh: 模型功能的改进导致了使用量的快速增加。

sentences.en: According to OpenRouter's token consumption, Hy3 has consistently ranked among the top three globally since its launch.
sentences.zh: 根据OpenRouter的代币消耗情况，Hy3自上线以来一直稳居全球前三。

sentences.en: Additionally, the daily token usage of Hy3 is seven times that of the preview version, reflecting faster user adoption and rising paid demand.
sentences.zh: 此外，Hy3 的每日代币使用量是预览版的七倍，反映出用户采用速度加快和付费需求上升。

blocks.html_en: User choices provide more direct feedback. Among users who selected models in WorkBuddy, 60% chose Hy3; after integrating with ima Copilot, Hy3 became the most used model on the platform within 72 hours.

sentences.en: User choices provide more direct feedback.
sentences.zh: 用户的选择提供了更直接的反馈。

sentences.en: Among users who selected models in WorkBuddy, 60% chose Hy3; after integrating with ima Copilot, Hy3 became the most used model on the platform within 72 hours.
sentences.zh: 在WorkBuddy中选择车型的用户中，60%选择了Hy3；与ima Copilot集成后，Hy3在72小时内成为平台上使用最多的型号。

blocks.html_en: WorkBuddy continues to lead, Xiaowei expands gray-scale testing, and AI products achieve large-scale deployment

sentences.en: WorkBuddy continues to lead, Xiaowei expands gray-scale testing, and AI products achieve large-scale deployment
sentences.zh: WorkBuddy持续领先，小微拓展灰度测试，AI产品实现规模部署

blocks.html_en: While model iteration accelerates, Tencent's AI products begin to move from single breakthroughs to scaling up: WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, and other office agents show clear growth momentum. The enterprise WeChat AI assistant "Dayuan" was launched, and the native WeChat AI assistant "Xiaowei" continues to expand its gray-scale testing. The creative intelligent agent Miora, which shares the same architecture as WorkBuddy, has also gone live full-time.

sentences.en: While model iteration accelerates, Tencent's AI products begin to move from single breakthroughs to scaling up: WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, and other office agents show clear growth momentum.
sentences.zh: 在模型迭代加速的同时，腾讯的AI产品开始从单一突破走向规模化：WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy等办公代理呈现出明显的增长势头。

sentences.en: The enterprise WeChat AI assistant "Dayuan" was launched, and the native WeChat AI assistant "Xiaowei" continues to expand its gray-scale testing.
sentences.zh: 企业微信AI助手“大元”上线，原生微信AI助手“小微”持续拓展灰度测试。

sentences.en: The creative intelligent agent Miora, which shares the same architecture as WorkBuddy, has also gone live full-time.
sentences.zh: 与WorkBuddy相同架构的创意智能代理Miora也已全职上线。

blocks.html_en: Among these, office agents first formed a matrix advantage. WorkBuddy achieved rapid user growth and healthy user retention rates, with strong user willingness to subscribe and recharge tokens. Thanks to strong harness engineering capabilities, a rich selection of models, and an industry-leading skill library, WorkBuddy has become a leading AI-native office intelligence agent in China.

sentences.en: Among these, office agents first formed a matrix advantage.
sentences.zh: 其中，办公代理商首先形成了矩阵优势。

sentences.en: WorkBuddy achieved rapid user growth and healthy user retention rates, with strong user willingness to subscribe and recharge tokens.
sentences.zh: WorkBuddy 实现了快速的用户增长和健康的用户保留率，用户认购和充值的意愿强烈。

sentences.en: Thanks to strong harness engineering capabilities, a rich selection of models, and an industry-leading skill library, WorkBuddy has become a leading AI-native office intelligence agent in China.
sentences.zh: 凭借强大的线束工程能力、丰富的模型选择以及行业领先的技能库，WorkBuddy已成为国内领先的AI原生办公智能代理。

blocks.html_en: According to the E-consulting "Market Insight Report on Chinese Office Intelligence Platforms Q2 2026", the PC access volume of WorkBuddy reached 20.97 million times in June, ranking first among similar products domestically, exceeding the combined access volumes of the second and third places; in the monthly access volume top ten list, Tencent occupied four positions, with WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, QClaw, and Marvis all included.

sentences.en: According to the E-consulting "Market Insight Report on Chinese Office Intelligence Platforms Q2 2026", the PC access volume of WorkBuddy reached 20.97 million times in June, ranking first among similar products domestically, exceeding the combined access volumes of the second and third places; in the monthly access volume top ten list, Tencent occupied four positions, with WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, QClaw, and Marvis all included.
sentences.zh: 据易咨询《2026年第二季度中国办公智能平台市场洞察报告》显示，6月份WorkBuddy PC访问量达到2097万次，位居国内同类产品第一，超过第二名和第三名的访问量总和；在月度访问量前十榜单中，腾讯占据四席，WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy、QClaw、Marvis 全部入围。

blocks.html_en: Based on its own ecosystem advantages, Tencent is amplifying the differentiated competitiveness of office intelligence agents. WorkBuddy can integrate with WeChat and Enterprise WeChat, deeply entering real work scenarios. Recently, it also connected document and knowledge base workflows, and launched the "Human-Machine Dual Writing" function, exploring a new form of Office in the AI era.

sentences.en: Based on its own ecosystem advantages, Tencent is amplifying the differentiated competitiveness of office intelligence agents.
sentences.zh: 腾讯基于自身生态优势，正在放大办公智能代理的差异化竞争力。

sentences.en: WorkBuddy can integrate with WeChat and Enterprise WeChat, deeply entering real work scenarios.
sentences.zh: WorkBuddy可以与微信、企业微信集成，深度进入真实工作场景。

sentences.en: Recently, it also connected document and knowledge base workflows, and launched the "Human-Machine Dual Writing" function, exploring a new form of Office in the AI era.
sentences.zh: 近期，它还打通了文档和知识库工作流程，并推出了“人机双写”功能，探索AI时代的Office新形态。

blocks.html_en: Outside of personal office, the application boundaries of Tencent's office agents are also expanding into enterprises and industries. Currently, WorkBuddy has been applied in over 50 industries, covering areas such as government affairs, production, and life services, and has been implemented in scenarios like Guangdong government affairs and Shenzhen Port. The enterprise version of WorkBuddy has been officially launched, with commercialization and ecological cooperation proceeding simultaneously.

sentences.en: Outside of personal office, the application boundaries of Tencent's office agents are also expanding into enterprises and industries.
sentences.zh: 除了个人办公之外，腾讯办公代理的应用边界也在向企业和行业拓展。

sentences.en: Currently, WorkBuddy has been applied in over 50 industries, covering areas such as government affairs, production, and life services, and has been implemented in scenarios like Guangdong government affairs and Shenzhen Port.
sentences.zh: 目前，WorkBuddy已应用于50多个行业，涵盖政务、生产、生活服务等领域，并在广东政务、深圳口岸等场景落地。

sentences.en: The enterprise version of WorkBuddy has been officially launched, with commercialization and ecological cooperation proceeding simultaneously.
sentences.zh: WorkBuddy企业版已正式上线，商业化与生态合作同步推进。

blocks.html_en: The AI layout in the enterprise segment continues to deepen into existing collaboration channels. In the second quarter, Enterprise WeChat launched several AI functions including recording face-to-face meetings and intelligent documents, and introduced the intelligent assistant "Dayuan," directly embedded in the workflow, covering scenarios such as group chats, to-do lists, and emails. It can complete tasks such as chat summaries, document and table reading and writing, and project progress summaries, and connect external WeChat group chats, more naturally integrating into the enterprise collaboration process.

sentences.en: The AI layout in the enterprise segment continues to deepen into existing collaboration channels.
sentences.zh: 企业领域的AI布局持续深入现有协作渠道。

sentences.en: In the second quarter, Enterprise WeChat launched several AI functions including recording face-to-face meetings and intelligent documents, and introduced the intelligent assistant "Dayuan," directly embedded in the workflow, covering scenarios such as group chats, to-do lists, and emails.
sentences.zh: 第二季度，企业微信推出了录制面对面会议、智能文档等多项人工智能功能，并推出了直接嵌入工作流程的智能助手“大元”，覆盖群聊、待办事项、电子邮件等场景。

sentences.en: It can complete tasks such as chat summaries, document and table reading and writing, and project progress summaries, and connect external WeChat group chats, more naturally integrating into the enterprise collaboration process.
sentences.zh: 可以完成聊天总结、文档表格读写、项目进度总结等任务，并连接外部微信群聊，更自然地融入企业协作流程。

blocks.html_en: Outside of office and enterprise scenarios, Tencent's AI products are also accelerating into personal life scenarios. The native WeChat AI assistant "Xiaowei" launched in June continues to expand its gray-scale testing, with entry points extending from the main entrance of WeChat's home screen to more scenarios such as Moments, official accounts, and video numbers. Xiaowei is based on the self-developed WeLM model by the WeChat team, focusing on user privacy, WeChat scenario adaptation, and inference efficiency, while enhancing personalized AI experiences through official accounts and video numbers.

sentences.en: Outside of office and enterprise scenarios, Tencent's AI products are also accelerating into personal life scenarios.
sentences.zh: 除了办公和企业场景之外，腾讯的AI产品也正在加速进入个人生活场景。

sentences.en: The native WeChat AI assistant "Xiaowei" launched in June continues to expand its gray-scale testing, with entry points extending from the main entrance of WeChat's home screen to more scenarios such as Moments, official accounts, and video numbers.
sentences.zh: 6月份推出的微信原生AI助手“小微”继续扩大灰度测试，入口点从微信主屏主入口延伸至朋友圈、公众号、视频号等更多场景。

sentences.en: Xiaowei is based on the self-developed WeLM model by the WeChat team, focusing on user privacy, WeChat scenario adaptation, and inference efficiency, while enhancing personalized AI experiences through official accounts and video numbers.
sentences.zh: 小微基于微信团队自主研发的WeLM模型，专注于用户隐私、微信场景适配和推理效率，同时通过公众号和视频号增强个性化AI体验。

blocks.html_en: Yuanbao continues to strengthen core experiences such as search and voice recognition, and reuses the accumulated AI atomic capabilities in products like WeChat, WorkBuddy, and QQ Browser.

sentences.en: Yuanbao continues to strengthen core experiences such as search and voice recognition, and reuses the accumulated AI atomic capabilities in products like WeChat, WorkBuddy, and QQ Browser.
sentences.zh: 元宝持续强化搜索、语音识别等核心体验，并复用微信、WorkBuddy、QQ浏览器等产品中积累的AI原子能力。

blocks.html_en: AI drives cloud service growth, games and advertising maintain growth, and several long-standing games see record daily active users

sentences.en: AI drives cloud service growth, games and advertising maintain growth, and several long-standing games see record daily active users
sentences.zh: AI驱动云服务增长，游戏广告保持增长，多款老牌游戏日活跃用户创历史新高

blocks.html_en: In the second quarter, all three of Tencent's major business segments achieved growth, with the contribution of AI core businesses deepening. Among them, financial technology and enterprise services revenue increased by 9% to 60.29 billion yuan, with cloud services becoming the most direct contributor to AI-driven growth.

sentences.en: In the second quarter, all three of Tencent's major business segments achieved growth, with the contribution of AI core businesses deepening.
sentences.zh: 第二季度，腾讯三大业务板块均实现增长，AI核心业务贡献不断深化。

sentences.en: Among them, financial technology and enterprise services revenue increased by 9% to 60.29 billion yuan, with cloud services becoming the most direct contributor to AI-driven growth.
sentences.zh: 其中，金融科技和企业服务收入增长9%至602.9亿元，云服务成为人工智能驱动增长最直接的贡献者。

blocks.html_en: Specifically, the growth in demand for model inference, intelligent body operation, and AI-native applications has driven increased demand for computing power, MaaS, and API calls. AI products and services such as WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy also contributed new revenue. Tencent Cloud's overseas business continued to expand rapidly, with this quarter supporting Indonesia's leading operator XLSMART in a large-scale public cloud migration and applying WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy AI capabilities in the migration process; general cloud service demand also maintained growth.

sentences.en: Specifically, the growth in demand for model inference, intelligent body operation, and AI-native applications has driven increased demand for computing power, MaaS, and API calls.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，模型推理、智能体操作、AI原生应用等需求的增长带动了算力、MaaS、API调用等需求的增长。

sentences.en: AI products and services such as WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy also contributed new revenue.
sentences.zh: WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy等AI产品和服务也贡献了新的收入。

sentences.en: Tencent Cloud's overseas business continued to expand rapidly, with this quarter supporting Indonesia's leading operator XLSMART in a large-scale public cloud migration and applying WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy AI capabilities in the migration process; general cloud service demand also maintained growth.
sentences.zh: 腾讯云海外业务持续快速扩张，本季度支持印尼领先运营商XLSMART进行大规模公有云迁移，并在迁移过程中应用WorkBuddy和CodeBuddy AI能力；总体云服务需求也保持增长。

blocks.html_en: In gaming, AI has become an important force driving business growth and has been deeply integrated into the entire player experience, development production, and operation service chain. For example, "Delta Operation" uses Agents to improve operational efficiency and leverages Hy3D capabilities to optimize the scene-end hand integration production pipeline.

sentences.en: In gaming, AI has become an important force driving business growth and has been deeply integrated into the entire player experience, development production, and operation service chain.
sentences.zh: 在游戏领域，人工智能已成为驱动业务增长的重要力量，并深度融入整个玩家体验、开发生产、运营服务链。

sentences.en: For example, "Delta Operation" uses Agents to improve operational efficiency and leverages Hy3D capabilities to optimize the scene-end hand integration production pipeline.
sentences.zh: 例如，《三角洲行动》利用Agents提升运营效率，利用Hy3D能力优化场景端手工整合生产流水线。

blocks.html_en: At the same time, the exploration of AI and gameplay integration continues. The AI NPC gameplay of "PUBG Mobile" has accumulated 167 million users, with the highest daily active users reaching 17.7 million; the new game "Kingdom of Roche: World" introduced a game-native Coach Agent "Scarlett" for complex gameplay decision-making, which has effectively promoted PVP ice-breaking and activity since its launch, increasing PVP activation by 20%, and improving win rates after users engaged with the features, thus enhancing the gameplay experience.

sentences.en: At the same time, the exploration of AI and gameplay integration continues.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，AI与游戏玩法融合的探索仍在继续。

sentences.en: The AI NPC gameplay of "PUBG Mobile" has accumulated 167 million users, with the highest daily active users reaching 17.7 million; the new game "Kingdom of Roche: World" introduced a game-native Coach Agent "Scarlett" for complex gameplay decision-making, which has effectively promoted PVP ice-breaking and activity since its launch, increasing PVP activation by 20%, and improving win rates after users engaged with the features, thus enhancing the gameplay experience.
sentences.zh: 《PUBG Mobile》的AI NPC玩法已累计用户1.67亿，最高日活跃用户达到1770万；新游戏《罗氏王国：世界》引入了游戏原生教练代理“斯嘉丽”进行复杂的游戏决策，自上线以来有效促进了PVP破冰和活跃度，使PVP活跃度提高了20%，并提高了用户参与该功能后的胜率，从而增强了游戏体验。

blocks.html_en: In terms of business performance, the game revenue for this quarter reached 65.9 billion yuan, up 11% year-over-year, returning to double-digit growth. Domestic market revenue reached 47.3 billion yuan, up 17% year-over-year. The growth drivers mainly come from four core products: "Delta Operation," "Valorant," "Valorant: Energy Operation," and "Kingdom of Roche: World." Among them, the daily active users of "Delta Operation" and "Valorant" both reached historic highs this quarter, maintaining Tencent's leading position in the shooting category and competitive arena.

sentences.en: In terms of business performance, the game revenue for this quarter reached 65.9 billion yuan, up 11% year-over-year, returning to double-digit growth.
sentences.zh: 经营业绩方面，本季度游戏收入达到659亿元，同比增长11%，重回两位数增长。

sentences.en: Domestic market revenue reached 47.3 billion yuan, up 17% year-over-year.
sentences.zh: 国内市场收入达473亿元，同比增长17%。

sentences.en: The growth drivers mainly come from four core products: "Delta Operation," "Valorant," "Valorant: Energy Operation," and "Kingdom of Roche: World."
sentences.zh: 增长动力主要来自《三角洲行动》、《Valorant》、《Valorant：能源行动》、《罗氏王国：世界》四款核心产品。

sentences.en: Among them, the daily active users of "Delta Operation" and "Valorant" both reached historic highs this quarter, maintaining Tencent's leading position in the shooting category and competitive arena.
sentences.zh: 其中，《三角洲行动》和《Valorant》的日活跃用户本季度均创历史新高，保持了腾讯在射击品类和竞技赛场的领先地位。

blocks.html_en: International game market revenue reached 18.6 billion yuan, up 4% year-over-year on a fixed exchange rate basis, mainly driven by "Arknights" and "VALORANT"; meanwhile, Miniclip under Tencent achieved a breakthrough success in the international market, with the product "Arrows - Puzzle Escape" becoming the top downloaded mobile game globally in the second quarter.

sentences.en: International game market revenue reached 18.6 billion yuan, up 4% year-over-year on a fixed exchange rate basis, mainly driven by "Arknights" and "VALORANT"; meanwhile, Miniclip under Tencent achieved a breakthrough success in the international market, with the product "Arrows - Puzzle Escape" becoming the top downloaded mobile game globally in the second quarter.
sentences.zh: 国际游戏市场收入达186亿元，按固定汇率计算同比增长4%，主要由《明日方舟》和《VALORANT》拉动；与此同时，腾讯旗下Miniclip在国际市场取得突破性成功，产品《箭之密室逃脱》成为第二季度全球下载量第一的手游。

blocks.html_en: In marketing services, AI continues to drive improvements in advertising campaign efficiency. Marketing services revenue for this quarter reached 43.57 billion yuan, up 22% year-over-year, continuing to grow faster than the industry. The customer coverage of the "Tencent Marketing AIM+" smart advertising product matrix remains above 80%, with AI creative capabilities improving material production efficiency by nearly 80%.

sentences.en: In marketing services, AI continues to drive improvements in advertising campaign efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在营销服务中，人工智能持续推动广告活动效率的提高。

sentences.en: Marketing services revenue for this quarter reached 43.57 billion yuan, up 22% year-over-year, continuing to grow faster than the industry.
sentences.zh: 本季度营销服务收入达435.7亿元，同比增长22%，继续快于行业增速。

sentences.en: The customer coverage of the "Tencent Marketing AIM+" smart advertising product matrix remains above 80%, with AI creative capabilities improving material production efficiency by nearly 80%.
sentences.zh: “腾讯营销AIM+”智能广告产品矩阵客户覆盖率保持在80%以上，AI创意能力提升素材生产效率近80%。

blocks.html_en: The advertising recommendation model "Scaling Up" has been upgraded to build a new generation of advertising training and inference infrastructural technology base. Taking the video number advertising recommendation scenario as an example, the scale of the ultra-large sorting model increased by 30 times, and the computational workload increased by 24 times, with these capabilities now extended to more WeChat scenarios such as official accounts and mini programs.

sentences.en: The advertising recommendation model "Scaling Up" has been upgraded to build a new generation of advertising training and inference infrastructural technology base.
sentences.zh: 广告推荐模型“Scaling Up”升级，打造新一代广告训练和推理基础设施技术基地。

sentences.en: Taking the video number advertising recommendation scenario as an example, the scale of the ultra-large sorting model increased by 30 times, and the computational workload increased by 24 times, with these capabilities now extended to more WeChat scenarios such as official accounts and mini programs.
sentences.zh: 以视频号广告推荐场景为例，超大规模排序模型规模增加了30倍，计算量增加了24倍，目前这些能力已经扩展到公众号、小程序等更多微信场景。

blocks.html_en: AI is also accelerating integration into WeChat's existing products and ecosystem. In addition to launching the AI assistant Xiaowei, the appeal of the mini program ecosystem to developers continues to grow, with AI-native applications accelerating their emergence, and AI application mini programs growing nearly 40% in half a year. The "WeChat Mini Program Growth Plan" has increased the large model token quota to 1 billion, attracting 63,000 mini programs to participate, with over 60% coming from individual developers; official accounts have launched AI one-click formatting and are conducting gray-scale testing of AI avatars, improving content creation and user service efficiency; WeChat Pay has launched the "AI Dedicated Card," which is the first to be integrated with WorkBuddy, allowing users to express consumer needs to the intelligent agent, experiencing an automated consumer cycle from intelligent recommendations, ordering to payment.

sentences.en: AI is also accelerating integration into WeChat's existing products and ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 人工智能也正在加速融入微信现有的产品和生态系统。

sentences.en: In addition to launching the AI assistant Xiaowei, the appeal of the mini program ecosystem to developers continues to grow, with AI-native applications accelerating their emergence, and AI application mini programs growing nearly 40% in half a year.
sentences.zh: 除了推出AI助手小微外，小程序生态对开发者的吸引力持续增长，AI原生应用加速涌现，AI应用小程序半年增长近40%。

sentences.en: The "WeChat Mini Program Growth Plan" has increased the large model token quota to 1 billion, attracting 63,000 mini programs to participate, with over 60% coming from individual developers; official accounts have launched AI one-click formatting and are conducting gray-scale testing of AI avatars, improving content creation and user service efficiency; WeChat Pay has launched the "AI Dedicated Card," which is the first to be integrated with WorkBuddy, allowing users to express consumer needs to the intelligent agent, experiencing an automated consumer cycle from intelligent recommendations, ordering to payment.
sentences.zh: “微信小程序成长计划”将大模通证额度提升至10亿，吸引6.3万个小程序参与，其中超过60%来自个人开发者；公众号上线AI一键格式化，并对AI头像进行灰度测试，提升内容创作和用户服务效率；微信支付推出“AI专卡”，率先与WorkBuddy集成，让用户向智能客服表达消费需求，体验从智能推荐、下单到支付的自动化消费周期。

blocks.html_en: Rich AI capabilities continue to activate the WeChat ecosystem. This quarter, the combined monthly active accounts of WeChat and WeChat reached 1.439 billion, with the total user usage time of the video number increasing by more than 20% year-over-year, driven by increasingly rich content for young users, upgrades in interactive functions, and a new content mixing system; during this year's "618" shopping festival, the transaction amount in the store and card package scenarios increased by 537%, becoming a new place for merchants' development, with the number of brands achieving a transaction volume of millions increasing by more than 200%, and the number of merchants achieving a transaction volume of millions increasing by 564%; mini program overseas services have further expanded, with the monthly transaction count in Southeast Asia increasing by 160% year-over-year.

content_html_zh:
8月12日，腾讯控股（00700.HK）发布第二季度财报，AI成为整个季度的核心主题：从不到三个月完成重构并推出Hy3预览版，到快速迭代到Hy3正式版，再到近期计划推出参数规模更大的Hy4，欢源正在形成稳定、系统的模型开发能力；腾讯在办公智能领域初步建立优势，多产品同时工作；微信AI助手“小微”于6月上线，并持续扩大灰度测试范围。

本季度腾讯基本面依然稳健：营收达到2047.9亿元，同比增长11%；非国际财务报告准则营业利润达756.4亿元，同比增长9%。 若剔除AI新产品（主要是Hy、元宝、CodeBuddy、WorkBuddy、小微）的影响，Non-IFRS营业利润增长19%至861亿元。

强大的商业模式和稳健的基本面支撑更实质性的人工智能投资：本季度研发支出达272.8亿元，同比增长35%；资本支出达527.8亿元，同比增长176%，环比增长65%。 若剔除算力采购预付款，自由现金流达376亿元。 随着人工智能为核心业务贡献更多增量价值，投资、实施和业务回报之间的正反馈循环正在逐渐加强。

腾讯董事长兼首席执行官马化腾表示：“进入今年第三季度，我们正在智能、应用、基础设施三个层面打造人工智能赋能的新腾讯，并取得重大进展。 在智能层，Hy3正式版为用户提供了广泛适用且高性价比的车型，为Hy系列车型达到行业领先水平奠定了基础。 在应用层，人工智能办公效率服务WorkBuddy和人工智能编程工具CodeBuddy实现了突破性的用户增长，目前在各自领域处于国内领先地位。 在基础设施层，我们大幅增加了算力采购，这将有助于将应用和模型的使用转化为收入。 与此同时，我们不断完善现有业务，营销服务收入持续增长，多款新游戏表现良好，微信视频号播放量快速增长。”

Hy3性能与使用率齐升，Hy4即将接班，车型基础持续强化

经过对预训练、强化学习等基础设施的全面重构，欢源在本季度快速完成了 Hy3 从预览版到正式版的迭代，即将推出的 Hy4 将进一步提升模型性能和多模态能力。

作为本次迭代的核心成果，Hy3展现出了更高的“智能密度”，在参数规模相对较小的情况下，达到了媲美国内外旗舰车型2-5倍的智能水平。

模型与AI产品Co-Design（协同设计）也成为寰远迭代升级的重要路径。 目前，Hy3已快速集成到WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy、元宝、ima、Marvis等产品中，带来明显的体验提升。 其中，WorkBuddy的任务解决率从72%提升至90%。

模型功能的改进导致了使用量的快速增加。 根据OpenRouter的代币消耗情况，Hy3自上线以来一直稳居全球前三。 此外，Hy3 的每日代币使用量是预览版的七倍，反映出用户采用速度加快和付费需求上升。

用户的选择提供了更直接的反馈。 在WorkBuddy中选择车型的用户中，60%选择了Hy3；与ima Copilot集成后，Hy3在72小时内成为平台上使用最多的型号。

WorkBuddy持续领先，小微拓展灰度测试，AI产品实现规模部署

在模型迭代加速的同时，腾讯的AI产品开始从单一突破走向规模化：WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy等办公代理呈现出明显的增长势头。 企业微信AI助手“大元”上线，原生微信AI助手“小微”持续拓展灰度测试。 与WorkBuddy相同架构的创意智能代理Miora也已全职上线。

其中，办公代理商首先形成了矩阵优势。 WorkBuddy 实现了快速的用户增长和健康的用户保留率，用户认购和充值的意愿强烈。 凭借强大的线束工程能力、丰富的模型选择以及行业领先的技能库，WorkBuddy已成为国内领先的AI原生办公智能代理。

据易咨询《2026年第二季度中国办公智能平台市场洞察报告》显示，6月份WorkBuddy PC访问量达到2097万次，位居国内同类产品第一，超过第二名和第三名的访问量总和；在月度访问量前十榜单中，腾讯占据四席，WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy、QClaw、Marvis 全部入围。

腾讯基于自身生态优势，正在放大办公智能代理的差异化竞争力。 WorkBuddy可以与微信、企业微信集成，深度进入真实工作场景。 近期，它还打通了文档和知识库工作流程，并推出了“人机双写”功能，探索AI时代的Office新形态。

除了个人办公之外，腾讯办公代理的应用边界也在向企业和行业拓展。 目前，WorkBuddy已应用于50多个行业，涵盖政务、生产、生活服务等领域，并在广东政务、深圳口岸等场景落地。 WorkBuddy企业版已正式上线，商业化与生态合作同步推进。

企业领域的AI布局持续深入现有协作渠道。 第二季度，企业微信推出了录制面对面会议、智能文档等多项人工智能功能，并推出了直接嵌入工作流程的智能助手“大元”，覆盖群聊、待办事项、电子邮件等场景。 可以完成聊天总结、文档表格读写、项目进度总结等任务，并连接外部微信群聊，更自然地融入企业协作流程。

除了办公和企业场景之外，腾讯的AI产品也正在加速进入个人生活场景。 6月份推出的微信原生AI助手“小微”继续扩大灰度测试，入口点从微信主屏主入口延伸至朋友圈、公众号、视频号等更多场景。 小微基于微信团队自主研发的WeLM模型，专注于用户隐私、微信场景适配和推理效率，同时通过公众号和视频号增强个性化AI体验。

元宝持续强化搜索、语音识别等核心体验，并复用微信、WorkBuddy、QQ浏览器等产品中积累的AI原子能力。

AI驱动云服务增长，游戏广告保持增长，多款老牌游戏日活跃用户创历史新高

第二季度，腾讯三大业务板块均实现增长，AI核心业务贡献不断深化。 其中，金融科技和企业服务收入增长9%至602.9亿元，云服务成为人工智能驱动增长最直接的贡献者。

具体来说，模型推理、智能体操作、AI原生应用等需求的增长带动了算力、MaaS、API调用等需求的增长。 WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy等AI产品和服务也贡献了新的收入。 腾讯云海外业务持续快速扩张，本季度支持印尼领先运营商XLSMART进行大规模公有云迁移，并在迁移过程中应用WorkBuddy和CodeBuddy AI能力；总体云服务需求也保持增长。

在游戏领域，人工智能已成为驱动业务增长的重要力量，并深度融入整个玩家体验、开发生产、运营服务链。 例如，《三角洲行动》利用Agents提升运营效率，利用Hy3D能力优化场景端手工整合生产流水线。

与此同时，AI与游戏玩法融合的探索仍在继续。 《PUBG Mobile》的AI NPC玩法已累计用户1.67亿，最高日活跃用户达到1770万；新游戏《罗氏王国：世界》引入了游戏原生教练代理“斯嘉丽”进行复杂的游戏决策，自上线以来有效促进了PVP破冰和活跃度，使PVP活跃度提高了20%，并提高了用户参与该功能后的胜率，从而增强了游戏体验。

经营业绩方面，本季度游戏收入达到659亿元，同比增长11%，重回两位数增长。 国内市场收入达473亿元，同比增长17%。 增长动力主要来自《三角洲行动》、《Valorant》、《Valorant：能源行动》、《罗氏王国：世界》四款核心产品。 其中，《三角洲行动》和《Valorant》的日活跃用户本季度均创历史新高，保持了腾讯在射击品类和竞技赛场的领先地位。

国际游戏市场收入达186亿元，按固定汇率计算同比增长4%，主要由《明日方舟》和《VALORANT》拉动；与此同时，腾讯旗下Miniclip在国际市场取得突破性成功，产品《箭之密室逃脱》成为第二季度全球下载量第一的手游。

在营销服务中，人工智能持续推动广告活动效率的提高。 本季度营销服务收入达435.7亿元，同比增长22%，继续快于行业增速。 “腾讯营销AIM+”智能广告产品矩阵客户覆盖率保持在80%以上，AI创意能力提升素材生产效率近80%。

广告推荐模型“Scaling Up”升级，打造新一代广告训练和推理基础设施技术基地。 以视频号广告推荐场景为例，超大规模排序模型规模增加了30倍，计算量增加了24倍，目前这些能力已经扩展到公众号、小程序等更多微信场景。

人工智能也正在加速融入微信现有的产品和生态系统。 除了推出AI助手小微外，小程序生态对开发者的吸引力持续增长，AI原生应用加速涌现，AI应用小程序半年增长近40%。 “微信小程序成长计划”将大模通证额度提升至10亿，吸引6.3万个小程序参与，其中超过60%来自个人开发者；公众号上线AI一键格式化，并对AI头像进行灰度测试，提升内容创作和用户服务效率；微信支付推出“AI专卡”，率先与WorkBuddy集成，让用户向智能客服表达消费需求，体验从智能推荐、下单到支付的自动化消费周期。

丰富的AI能力持续激活微信生态。 本季度，在年轻用户内容日益丰富、交互功能升级以及全新内容混搭系统的推动下，微信及微信月活跃账户合计达14.39亿，视频号用户总使用时长同比增长超过20%；今年“618”购物节期间，门店和卡包场景交易额增长537%，成为商户发展新地，百万交易额品牌数量增长超过200%，百万交易额商户数量增长564%；小程序海外服务进一步拓展，东南亚月交易笔数同比增长160%。
